description: This file defines the main page component for a note-taking web application, managing state, UI layout, and interactions such as creating, editing, deleting, and filtering notes.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main React functional component representing the homepage with note management UI.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Opens the modal dialog to create a new note.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Opens the modal dialog with an existing note for editing.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the note form, adding or updating a note.

methods.name: requestDelete
methods.description: Initiates the delete process by opening a confirmation dialog.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms and executes the deletion of a note.
